title: Backend Architecture Stabilization and Native Terminal Reliability
objective: Audit, stabilize and improve the existing backend implementation established in the baseline, focusing on native terminal stability, PTY lifecycle, and CLI adapter reliability.
context: The baseline established native terminal PTY integration and 30+ CLI adapters. The backend specialist must harden error handling, prevent orphaned processes, ensure reliable process cancellation, and improve resource cleanup without breaking IPC contracts.
priorities: PTY process lifecycle and session management
Resource cleanup and orphaned process termination
Test coverage for terminal edge cases
expected_deliverables: Hardened PTY session lifecycle handling process exit, cancellation and cleanup
Zero orphaned processes on abrupt terminal closing or cancellation
Graceful handling of unhandled rejections in terminal and adapter subsystems
Unit and integration test coverage for terminal edge cases in tests/pty-terminal.test.ts
Completed HANDOFF.md with test logs and typecheck evidence
acceptance_criteria: Typecheck passes (0 errors across node and web targets)
All tests in tests/pty-terminal.test.ts and tests/adapters/** pass 100%
PTY process lifecycle cleanly handles exit, resize, signal propagation and resource cleanup
No orphaned ConPTY or cmd/powershell processes left in background after session termination
No unhandled promise rejections or main-process crashes under error conditions
No unauthorized modifications to protected shared files (src/shared/**, schema.ts, package.json)
Handoff submission created at .agents/coordination/agents/backend/HANDOFF.md with full verification evidence

risk_assessment.mitigation: Do not rewrite working subsystems without demonstrating concrete defects. Any necessary change to shared IPC contracts requires an ADR proposal to the Lead Architect.
